# Keeping your money safe: 2FA and device security


nsave team


Jan 5, 2026


A few small habits make it much harder for somebody else to access your account, even if they learn your password.


## Secure your sign-in


### Use two-factor authentication


Keep your verification method private. nsave support will never ask you to read out a one-time code or approve an unfamiliar sign-in.


### Protect your recovery details


- Use a unique password for the email linked to your account.
- Keep your registered phone number up to date.
- Store backup codes somewhere separate from your phone.


## Review active devices


Remove old or unrecognised sessions immediately. If anything looks suspicious, freeze your cards and contact support from inside the app.
